uncited: - **TSDF Volume:** A 3D grid of floats storing fused signed distance values.
- Project all Gaussian centers to contracted space: $x_c = \text{contract}(x)$.
- Compute the norm of each contracted center: $n_i = \|x_{c,i}\|$.
- Calculate the 95th percentile of these norms: $R_{raw} = \text{quantile}(n, 0.95)$.
Sample depth $d_k$ from the rendered depth map at $\text{pix\_coords}$ using bilinear interpolation.
- **Time Complexity:** Dominated by the SDF evaluation for every voxel in the grid ($N^3$) and for every vertex during coloring.
Each SDF evaluation iterates over all training cameras.
- **Memory Complexity:** $O(N^3)$ for the SDF grid if evaluated densely, or $O(V)$ if evaluated sparsely/chunked.
